title: Warhawk
description:
Fly your Warhawk ship, pew pew... 

based on the award winning Commodore 64 game, enhanced and brought to the PC and the ZX Spectrum Next.

This game has been carefully renovated from its original 1986 release by one of the developers of the original game, whilst also retaining its original feel and hectic playability.

 

Featuring 

• 20 frantic levels

• 10 large bosses and 10 mini bosses

• Glorious music throughout 

• Non-stop blasting action

• An army of dangerous enemies

• Stunning 8-bit graphics 

The game also includes wallpapers along with the entire soundtrack album.
description_short: Blast away in this pure retro-styled shooter and battle through tons of dangerous levels and manic boss fights.
